note: G2 zombie AI (game balance, not real-world data). Zombies only pursue the closest hostile and strike it in melee: no weapon, no grenades, no cover. speed_mps sits between the jog and the sprint of content/settings/movement.json (W1 cuts all movement speeds by 15 %). The model is content/characters/zombie.glb (RINONO, CC-BY-4.0, docs/credits.md) with its own clips: the blow lands at the attack clip's swing frame played at attack_rate (windup_s is the fallback without clips).

pack.note: PF1 hordes: with more than min_zombies alive, zombies run in packs of up to `size`. Only the leader picks a target and requests paths; followers slide along the navmesh to a wedge slot slot_spacing_m apart behind it (separation within separation_m, alignment to the leader's velocity), catch up at catch_up x speed while the leader keeps leader_pace, break off to strike any hostile within break_off_m, and path on their own beyond lost_m. A packless zombie joins the nearest pack leader within join_m.

lod.note: PF1: clips are sampled at anim_hz_near beyond anim_near_m from the camera and at anim_hz_far beyond anim_far_m; a pack follower walking beyond share_pose_m wears its leader's pose and skinned mesh.
